svg.title: Draw it: two steps, and the column that took over
svg.desc: A large empty dashed frame for the student to draw in, with three instructions underneath: draw the assign step and the move step on the same eight points with one squared distance written out in full, write the sigma sum beside the symbol with all eight terms and the total, and draw the unscaled wine clustering as three non-overlapping proline bands with the spread 314.91 labelled on it.
svg.text: Draw it: two steps, and the column that took over
1. ASSIGN and MOVE on the eight points, with one squared distance written out in full
2. the sigma symbol with all eight terms beside it, and the total 12.5000
3. the unscaled wine clusters as proline bands 278–590, 600–937, 970–1680, spread 314.91
